en: A colored illustration of a European city street with historic multi‑story buildings. On the left is a long, brown Renaissance/Baroque palace-like structure with many small windows and a clock tower with a green roof rising from the roofline. Ornate façades and bay windows line the street. In the distance, several church towers and domes with green copper roofs and tall spires dominate the skyline. The street below is busy with pedestrians, early 20th‑century style streetlights, and an electric tram car. There is no visible printed caption or legible text on the front.
